result.markdown: --- title: "Data" subtitle: "Files, stable URLs, and what's in them" --- ## Files The regions are published at stable URLs under ``` https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/ ``` The same files are in the R package, in [inst/extdata](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/tree/main/inst/extdata) (find them with `system.file("extdata", package = "measoshapes")`), and are created by [data-raw/export.R](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/blob/main/data-raw/export.R). ::: {#tbl-files .cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |file |crs |geometry | rows|size | |:---------------------------------|:------------------------------------|:------------|----:|:------| |[measo_regions06_ll.geojson](https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/measo_regions06_ll.geojson)|longitude/latitude (OGC:CRS84) |MULTIPOLYGON | 20|11 kB | |[measo_regions06_epsg_3031.parquet](https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/measo_regions06_epsg_3031.parquet)|polar stereographic (EPSG:3031) |POLYGON | 20|312 kB | ::: ::: and a QGIS style, [measo_regions06.qml](https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/measo_regions06.qml) (see [QGIS](qgis.qmd)). Which to use: * **Polar equal area** (`measo_regions06.*`): areas, maps of the Southern Ocean, overlays with polar data. * **Longitude/latitude** (`measo_regions06_ll.*`): assigning regions to longitude/latitude data, web maps. Boundaries are straight in longitude/latitude (see [Definition](definition.qmd)). * **EPSG:3031** (`measo_regions06_epsg_3031.*`): polar stereographic maps, e.g. Quantarctica. Not equal area. * **GeoParquet** for data tools (R, Python, DuckDB, the browser); **FlatGeobuf** for GIS and streaming; **GeoJSON** for simple web maps. ## Columns ::: {#tbl-columns .cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} |name |label |sector |zone |fill |colour | |:----|:---------------------------|:-------------|:------------|:-------|:------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| |AOA |Antarctic Atlantic |Atlantic |Antarctic |#F9BDBC | | |AOS |Subantarctic Atlantic |Atlantic |Subantarctic |#F27071 | | |AON |Northern Atlantic |Atlantic |Northern |#E11F26 | | |AOT |Temperate Atlantic |Atlantic |NA |NA | | |CIA |Antarctic Central Indian |CentralIndian |Antarctic |#F9D7C2 | | |CIS |Subantarctic Central Indian |CentralIndian |Subantarctic |#F4B187 | | |CIN |Northern Central Indian |CentralIndian |Northern |#EC8444 | | |CIT |Temperate Central Indian |CentralIndian |NA |NA | | |EIA |Antarctic East Indian |EastIndian |Antarctic |#D1D3EA | | |EIS |Subantarctic East Indian |EastIndian |Subantarctic |#B0B4D9 | | |EIN |Northern East Indian |EastIndian |Northern |#878DC5 | | |EIT |Temperate East Indian |EastIndian |NA |NA | | |WPA |Antarctic West Pacific |WestPacific |Antarctic |#E0B8D6 | | |WPS |Subantarctic West Pacific |WestPacific |Subantarctic |#C579B2 | | |WPN |Northern West Pacific |WestPacific |Northern |#843A75 | | |WPT |Temperate West Pacific |WestPacific |NA |NA | | |EPA |Antarctic East Pacific |EastPacific |Antarctic |#9FC5C7 | | |EPS |Subantarctic East Pacific |EastPacific |Subantarctic |#609FA0 | | |EPN |Northern East Pacific |EastPacific |Northern |#4B7E7F | | |EPT |Temperate East Pacific |EastPacific |NA |NA | | ::: ::: * `name`: region code, sector code then zone code (T for the temperate regions). * `label`: full name, zone then sector, e.g. "Antarctic Atlantic". * `sector`: one of Atlantic, CentralIndian, EastIndian, WestPacific, EastPacific. * `zone`: Antarctic, Subantarctic, Northern; empty for the T regions (outside MEASO). * `fill`: the region's colour in the MEASO Summary for Policymakers (Figure 5), as `#RRGGBB`; empty for the T regions. ## Versions The `v06` in the URL is the version of the regions. Version 06 has the boundaries of version 05, with one row per region, labels, and the published colours; see [Definition](definition.qmd#history) and [News](news.qmd). Version 05 is available in the R package as released (`measo_regions05`), and as the geopackages in [inst/extdata](https://github.com/AustralianAntarcticDivision/measoshapes/tree/main/inst/extdata). ## Citing Please cite the measoshapes package: > Sumner, M.
